name: Michael Sikand
zh_summary:
$MRVL is the first company that's given visibility into photonics through 2030.

Revenue was $8.2B last year and the fiscal 2031 target is $70B to $90B. The TAM is 4x last investor day. Interconnect becomes the biggest segment at ~$37.5B

Now think about what this means for the suppliers. Nobody else in the photonics supply chain has guided out to 2030, but they all ride the same curves.

$LITE's CEO says they'll only be able to supply 30% of what customers want next year. Coherent's booked through the end of 2027.

So @AsymmetricBets_ ran Marvell's model on the 6 biggest beneficiaries: $LITE $COHR $AAOI $CIEN $TSEM $ALAB

Each one grows at its own market's rate, gets valued off historical multiples and has dilution baked in.

Bear, base and bull 2030 targets for all 7 are on my Substack below.
